items.title: Local installation and capability admission
items.scope: Version and installation discovery, local capability admission and source compatibility.
items.reentry_condition: Owner schedules the local Ollama scope in a future version; review retained implementation and actual sources before resuming. No automatic M7/M8 prerequisite.

historical_tickets.title: Inventory local Ollama installation
historical_tickets.work: Record real CLI and daemon version, trusted host, process ownership and response bounds without profile or agent mutation.
historical_tickets.done_when: Local version and availability have sanitized real evidence; missing or mismatched service is explicit.

historical_tickets.title: Implement installation and capability admission
historical_tickets.work: Implement provider manifest and installation discovery with separate client/daemon versions, source and compatibility.
historical_tickets.done_when: Each lane independently admits exact supported version/source; invalid lane fails before I/O; real installation produces provenance.
verification: adapter pure policy tests; real installation test (to be defined)

items.title: Local host and model inventory
items.scope: Endpoint discovery, local service health, installed/loaded model inventories, real empty and model-present verification.
items.reentry_condition: Owner schedules the local Ollama scope in a future version; review retained implementation and actual sources before resuming. No automatic M7/M8 prerequisite.

historical_tickets.title: Verify model-host read-only access
historical_tickets.work: Confirm the owner-selected local workstation endpoint and safe read-only access to its existing model; document the exposed surface before requests. The earlier remote-host assumption is superseded.
historical_tickets.done_when: One approved reachable real host and model state, or specific documented blocker; no daemon change or LAN exposure.
verification: read-only host and API discovery; exact command selected after host/trust review

historical_tickets.title: Implement local catalog and loaded-model observation
historical_tickets.work: Use bounded local GET version/tags/ps sources, map installed and loaded models with source/time and real empty/offline states.
historical_tickets.done_when: Actual empty and real model-present cases render distinctly; no inference/loading request or mutation.
verification: real local service integration tests and browser checks (to be defined)

items.title: Local processes, resources and correlation
items.scope: Local Ollama process discovery, hierarchy, CPU/RAM/GPU where safely available, model/account correlation and representative process evidence.
items.reentry_condition: Owner schedules the local Ollama scope in a future version; review retained implementation and actual sources before resuming. No automatic M7/M8 prerequisite.

historical_tickets.title: Discover real Ollama processes and correlation
historical_tickets.work: Read approved process metadata, distinguish loaded model and active client, preserve evidence-backed hierarchy and unresolved links.
historical_tickets.done_when: Representative real processes display correct sampled state/paths where permitted; no environment, prompt, response, source or process mutation.
verification: real Linux process and provider checks (to be defined)

items.title: Local dashboard and integrated verification
items.scope: Local API/UI views, history/alerts where applicable, local failure/recovery, security, admission, deployment and live completion evidence. Cloud portions remain in M6.
items.reentry_condition: Owner schedules the local Ollama scope in a future version; review retained implementation and actual sources before resuming. No automatic M7/M8 prerequisite.

historical_tickets.title: Freeze capability and contract decisions
historical_tickets.work: Publish capability matrix and update A03 plan, data flow, source/version/rate, identity, contracts, migration and A03-M7 boundary.
historical_tickets.done_when: Every enabled lane has source decision and contract impact; owner approves exact implementation plan.

historical_tickets.title: Define canonical M6 completion gate
historical_tickets.work: Build versioned M6 completeness catalog and canonical AUTO-M6-EXIT before dependent closure; test blocked/failed/missing evidence.
historical_tickets.done_when: Gate checks M6-A01..A10 and five story deliverables, rejects skipped/missing evidence, emits one sanitized receipt; no repeated owner copy-paste.

historical_tickets.title: Implement dashboard views and provider filter
historical_tickets.work: Render Ollama account, organization, resource type, values, source, freshness, model/process and failure states via versioned API.
historical_tickets.done_when: Real Overview/detail/filter/history accessible on desktop and mobile; no placeholder values; existing promotion retained.
verification: real dashboard browser checks (to be defined)

historical_tickets.title: Verify failure isolation and natural recovery
historical_tickets.work: Exercise available real auth/offline/throttle/recovery conditions without stopping a user service, and verify Claude/Codex/dashboard continuity.
historical_tickets.done_when: Observed conditions pass with source/time; absent natural conditions remain Blocked/Not Run without simulation.
verification: real service and provider failure-isolation checks (to be defined)

historical_tickets.title: Security, compatibility and dependency review
historical_tickets.work: Review request scopes, secrets, allowed fields, no default-profile mutation, no agent control, dependencies/license and versioned contracts.
historical_tickets.done_when: Review names each finding and resolution; no mandatory security/privacy blocker remains; no new dependency without approval.
verification: bounded source and existing-evidence security/privacy review

historical_tickets.title: Run live end-to-end M6 scenarios
historical_tickets.work: Run fixed real test catalog and source-to-history/dashboard comparisons across SDK, EAIS and model host.
historical_tickets.done_when: Record exact observed pass/block outcomes, no hidden skips and no repeated owner attestations for unchanged evidence.

historical_tickets.title: Deploy, operate and close M6
historical_tickets.work: Run canonical gate, one bounded independent review, safe dashboard rollout/rollback and owner demonstration; record acceptance.
historical_tickets.done_when: Gate passed at exact revision, service responds, promotion retained, runbook updated, owner reviews once; M7/M8 remain separate.
